# Server Hands

> Phone-approved LUKS unlock for OpenMediaVault. Open the app, use your fingerprint, and your encrypted drives unlock end to end encrypted.

- [Docs](https://mblcdr.github.io/server-hands/docs/): Setup, packaging, protocol and security documentation for Server Hands.

## Docs

> Setup, packaging, protocol and security documentation for Server Hands.

- [Homelab setup](https://mblcdr.github.io/server-hands/docs/homelab-setup/): Set up the server, pair your phone and add post-unlock scripts.
- [Apt repository](https://mblcdr.github.io/server-hands/docs/apt-repo/): Install and upgrade the server package from the signed apt repository.
- [Android app release](https://mblcdr.github.io/server-hands/docs/android-release/): Build, sign and release the Android app.
- [iPhone, iPad and Mac app](https://mblcdr.github.io/server-hands/docs/apple-app/): Build, sign and run the SwiftUI app for iOS, iPadOS and macOS.
- [Protocol v1](https://mblcdr.github.io/server-hands/docs/protocol/): Wire format, encodings and cryptography used between the app and the server.
- [Threat model](https://mblcdr.github.io/server-hands/docs/threat-model/): What Server Hands protects, and against whom.
